versions.content: Proof of ownership message length check On reception of an Authentication (0x29) service with sub-function equal to proofOfOwnership, the Dcm shall verify that the message length fits to the size given in the parameters length- OfProofOfOwnershipClient and lengthOfEphemeralPublicKeyClient and return a NRC 0x13 if the size does not match.
